players.product: AI-enabled antibody and drug discovery programs

quarterly_data.signal: Lilly's Q2 2026 results release lists among its recent clinical updates: olomorasib received the U.S. FDA's Breakthrough Therapy designation for previously treated KRAS G12C-mutant advanced pancreatic cancer; Omvoh (mirikizumab-mrkz) demonstrated durable disease clearance in ulcerative colitis through four years, which Lilly calls a first for an IL-23p19 (company claim); Foundayo (orforglipron) was associated with significant weight loss in women at every stage of menopause; and Foundayo and lower-dose Zepbound helped people maintain weight loss after switching from higher doses of injectable incretin therapy in two late-phase trials.
quarterly_data.figure: olomorasib Breakthrough Therapy designation (pancreatic cancer); Omvoh durable ulcerative colitis disease clearance through four years; two late-phase weight-maintenance trials

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 Key Products revenue grew to $15.7 billion. By product: Ebglyss $201 million (+131%), Jaypirca $192 million, Kisunla $167 million, Omvoh $102 million (+36%), Foundayo $98 million (added to Key Products in Q2 2026) and Inluriyo $75 million. Lower realized prices outside the U.S. were driven primarily by the addition of Mounjaro to China's National Reimbursement Drug List in Q1 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Key Products $15.7 billion; Ebglyss $201 million (+131%); Jaypirca $192 million; Kisunla $167 million; Omvoh $102 million; Foundayo $98 million; Inluriyo $75 million

quarterly_data.signal: Business development and manufacturing per the Q2 2026 results release: Lilly completed the acquisitions of Orna Therapeutics, Ajax Therapeutics, Centessa Pharmaceuticals and Kelonia Therapeutics in Q2 2026, and after quarter end completed three acquisitions to build an infectious disease portfolio. Lilly also committed an additional $4.5 billion to expand its Indiana manufacturing sites.
quarterly_data.figure: four acquisitions completed in Q2 2026; three infectious disease acquisitions completed after quarter end; additional $4.5 billion for Indiana manufacturing sites
